dialogue_summary: The user and AI collaborate to build a 3D interactive portfolio website, resolving initial setup issues, deciding on a folder naming convention, and executing the wiring of the project scaffold and design tokens.

step_1_outcomes.text: Resolution of npm install issues and context sync
Decision on project folder naming convention
Wired project scaffold and design tokens

step_1_intentions.intention: Set up the development environment and project structure

step_2_requirements.text: The npm packages in the 'site' directory must be successfully installed.
step_2_requirements.rationale: The user's attempt to run 'npm install' in the 'site' directory establishes the installation of these packages as a mandatory task for their setup, which the AI subsequently verifies as completed.

step_2_requirements.text: The project context from the '3dinteractive portfolio website design' chat must be retrieved and synchronized to continue the development process.
step_2_requirements.rationale: The user explicitly requests to continue the session using the context from the '3dinteractive portfolio website design' chat, which the AI agrees to pull and subsequently uses to align the roadmap.

step_2_requirements.text: The project folder must be renamed to 'jayon-portfolio/' to ensure it is clean and matches the planning documents.
step_2_requirements.rationale: The user explicitly decides and instructs to rename the project folder to 'jayon-portfolio/' to match the plan documents.

step_2_requirements.text: The wiring plan must consist of three specific moves: stopping the server and renaming the folder, dropping in handoff, assets, and references, and wiring colors_and_type.css into the app.
step_2_requirements.rationale: The AI explicitly outlines these three specific moves as the required steps to complete the task.

step_2_requirements.text: The required project files (including handoff/CANONICAL_SPEC.md) must be verified as present on disk before starting the wiring process.
step_2_requirements.rationale: The AI states that these files are needed on disk and explicitly warns the user to flag if any are missing before starting.

step_2_requirements.text: The name field in package.json must be updated to match the new project name.
step_2_requirements.rationale: The AI explicitly instructs the user to update the package.json name field as part of the wiring process.

step_2_requirements.text: Leftover Vite files must be deleted from the project scaffold.
step_2_requirements.rationale: The AI explicitly instructs the user to delete leftover Vite files (junk) during the wiring process.

step_2_requirements.text: The wired project scaffold must be verified to start and run successfully on the development server using the provided testing checklist.
step_2_requirements.rationale: The AI provides a testing checklist and instructs the user to start the dev server and verify the setup before finishing.

step_2_requirements.text: The project folder must be renamed from 'site/' to 'jayon-portfolio/'.
step_2_requirements.rationale: The folder naming convention is resolved to 'jayon-portfolio/' as instructed in step 2.

step_2_slots.text: The project folder naming convention (e.g., 'site/' or 'jayon-portfolio/') must be decided by the user.
